description: Live smart-money signals for $BOBAI: the tax reserve charging the next buyback (wallet + contract queue = pending buy pressure), whale flows & holdings (auto-tracked wallets holding 0.5% of supply or more: 24h/7d in/outflows, top movers with tx, daily balance snapshots with 1d/7d/30d holdings trends), an immutable on-chain ledger of recent $100+ buys (size, buyer wallet, tx), and burn momentum. All verifiable, no API key. Use it to read buy pressure and what large holders do; for proof of past burns use bobai_activity, for one wallet’s balance bobai_wallet_balance.
name: bobai_smart_money
